values.note: 18 sites with parking spurs; up to 8 people, two tents and two vehicles or one RV per site. No length published.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/meridian-campground ('This campground has 18 campsites with parking spurs'; 'A maximum of eight people, two tents and two vehicles or one recreation vehicle (RV) is allowed per site'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Hand pump. recreation.gov alert (2026): 'There is no water available in this campground this season.' Water, trash and the host may be missing outside Memorial Day - Labor Day.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/meridian-campground ('two vault toilets at different locations'; 'Potable water is available at this site. A hand pump is available'; 'The area also has an extended season when services such as water, trash or a host may not be available in the fall and spring') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165445 (notice 'ALERT: There is no water available in this campground this season'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Forest Service: 'open late May to late September', weather dependent, with full service Memorial Day to Labor Day weekends. Dates are recreation.gov's 2026 first-come fee season (2027: May 28 - Sept 18).

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/meridian-campground ('This campground is open late May to late September'; 'Visitors may expect full service from Memorial Day weekend to Labor Day weekend') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165445/rates (First-come Season 2026-05-22 to 2026-09-19; 2027-05-28 to 2027-09-18), read 2026-10-28

values.note: First-come only: claim a site in person, then pay on site (cash, check, money order) or with recreation.gov Scan & Pay.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165445 ('This location is available on a first-come, first-served basis only. Scan and pay is available'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: $28 a site including two vehicles or one RV; $11 a night for a third vehicle.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/meridian-campground ('$28 fee per site for overnight camping. Two vehicles or one RV per site is included in the camping fee. $11 fee for a third vehicle') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165445/rates (2026-2028 WalkInScanPay1 28), read 2026-10-28

values.note: 50% off the site the pass holder occupies (concessionaire-run).

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/meridian-campground ('The Interagency Senior Pass and the Interagency Access Pass qualify for a 50% discount at concessionaire-run campsites'), read 2026-10-28

note: South Platte RD, Pike NF: ~9,000 ft on gravel Park County Route 43, which leaves US-285 at the top of Crow Hill toward Harris Park (near Bailey). --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov Scan & Pay listing: confirmed 18 FCFS sites, vault toilets, hand-pump water, $28; added season 05-22 to 09-19 (FS 'late May to late September' + rec.gov dates), fee detail, Senior/Access discount. No length published anywhere. Note trimmed of field facts.
flags: Missing phone: South Platte Ranger District 303-275-5610 (FS page contact). recreation.gov's facility-information line (303) 647-2366 is the concessionaire's.
Website is the forest home page; use https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/meridian-campground and the Scan & Pay listing https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/10165445.

Water conflict: FS page 'Potable water is available at this site. A hand pump is available' vs recreation.gov notice 'ALERT: There is no water available in this campground this season.' Kept potable_water true (FS) with the alert in the facilities note.

Length: no maximum on the FS page or recreation.gov (the catalog has one Scan and Pay placeholder site with no attributes); the FS page allows 'one recreation vehicle (RV)' per site with no rig wording. Nothing stored; nothing to compare.

Access: FS directions 'From U.S. Highway 285, turn north at the top of Crow Hill on to Park County Route 43 going towards the community of Harris Park.' No PSICC alert or order names CR 43, Harris Park or Meridian; the South Platte RD has a general downed-trees advisory after high winds.
Pin 39.51105,-105.53506 = the FS and recreation.gov coordinate; no per-site coordinates exist to compare.
Status: no closure posted; the 2026 fee season ended Sept 19.
